description: Dashboard for Spring Boot2.1 Statistics(based on Spring Boot2 Statistic by micrometer-prometheus).

targets.expr: irate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", application=~"$application", exception="None", uri!~".*actuator.*", uri=~"$uri_summary"}[5m]) / irate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", application=~"$application", exception="None", uri!~".*actuator.*", uri=~"$uri_summary"}[5m])

sum(irate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", application=~"$application", exception="None", uri!~".*actuator.*", uri=~"$uri_summary"}[5m])) /
sum(irate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", application=~"$application", exception="None", uri!~".*actuator.*", uri=~"$uri_summary"}[5m]))

irate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", application=~"$application", exception="None", uri!~".*actuator.*"}[5m]) / irate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", application=~"$application", exception="None", uri!~".*actuator.*"}[5m])

title: 3.1 Application Spring Boot 2.1 Statistics
